propositions: Acceptance criteria tagged [operator-attested] despite carrying exact repository path/symbol evidence (code-verifiable) bypassed the evidence-kind guard and completion verifier accepted the tag at face value, allowing attestation laundering on epic fb8a-7363-e406-4e36.

The evidence-kind routing criterion executed but failed to detect a tagged AC whose text cited repository paths (tests/unit/test_scan_scoping.py), an LLM judgment miss with no deterministic backstop; blocking was available but not deployed.

The det_measurement_provenance detector identified missing provenance: continuation lines on tagged ACs but wired as ADVISORY only (p6_ac_quality contract), so the plan-review verdict passed despite the defect.

A deterministic close-path guard (det_attestation_launder.py, txn.ensure_attested_items_valid) now fires before the completion verifier on [operator-attested] ACs citing exact repo paths/symbols (test files, ::node ids, src|tests|docs/... slashes), blocking with untag/split/provenance remedies.

Mixed-evidence ACs (repo-verifiable + external outcome) are now detected per-line with evidence-vs-orientation logic: test citations always fire; other repo citations fire only when preceded by evidence-introducing words; commits/Gerrit numbers never fire per ADR-0043.
Missing provenance: lines are rejected on the close path; retagging stales the signed plan-review attestation, requiring re-review via rebar review-plan.
